findings.title: Ancestor-directory metadata exemption preserves an undeclared engine-file oracle
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 6 requires that changing any undeclared repository file never yield a different verdict for the same candidate and frozen contract, and that undeclared metadata be unobservable.
findings.trigger: A D02-valid verifier branches on the metadata of an ancestor directory such as the engine root. After D02 and one verification, an undeclared engine file in that directory is renamed, added, or removed without changing any declared bytes, the candidate, or the frozen contract.
findings.consequence: The directory metadata changes and remains visible inside the verifier sandbox, allowing the same candidate and contract to receive contradictory PASS/FAIL verdicts based solely on an undeclared repository change.
findings.evidence: `transport.py:516-529` exempts every readable file's ancestors as literal paths from the metadata deny; lines 701 and 709-714 globally allow metadata and apply the deny only outside those exemptions. D08 supplies the verifier files with `metadata_denied=(self.engine_root,)` at lines 2060-2073, so the engine root itself becomes an exempt literal ancestor. Executing `PYTHONPATH=/Users/filipepinto/Projects/curriculum_builder python3 rc16_ancestor_metadata_repro.py` produced `literal_ancestor_exempted_from_metadata_deny: true`, `undeclared_path_named_by_profile: false`, `directory_metadata_changed: true`, and a verifier-equivalent stat branch changed from `PASS` to `FAIL` after renaming only an undeclared top-level engine file. The permanent regression at `test_plan26_transport.py:486-532` probes direct `stat` of a sibling file but does not probe observable ancestor-directory metadata.

observations: The review-bundle hash and all claimed graph/spec/schema/contract hashes recomputed correctly, including the required graph-v8 hash.
The real plan validator, complete-tree scanner, 75-claim ownership verifier, and fresh graph-v9 controller plan passed.
The RC14 declared-byte drift regression passed, as did focused D02 freeze and repair/revalidation tests.
The generated verifier profile denies networking and omits model-CLI authentication and scratch rules.
This managed QA process cannot nest `sandbox-exec`, and package mutation tests cannot edit the read-only repository copy. Those environmental failures were not treated as artifact findings.
reasoning: The direct RC14 byte-drift path is closed, and the intended direct RC15 sibling-file stat is denied by the generated policy. The remaining ancestor metadata exemption is nevertheless an observable channel from undeclared engine changes and directly defeats the absolute replay-invariance criterion. Environmental inability to launch a second Seatbelt sandbox was deliberately not promoted to a finding; the surviving blocker is grounded in the emitted policy and a filesystem reproduction of the permitted metadata signal.
